column1: # screen field batch 4: MultiplayerLobbyScreen (all 13 fields are read by this file only).
# initialMessage: the constructor argument shown once as a dialog and then cleared;
# backgroundImage/scrollPane/contentContainer: the fixed three-widget frame every menu screen sets
# lobbyButtons/lobbyLabels/lobbyDetailLabels: the 64 parallel rows - buttons, the title label and
#   the "LAN/Internet Game: ..." detail label, all indexed identically;
# statusLabel: the centred "Scanning for Games..." / "No Games Found" line;
# externalAddress: written by the scan thread from getAddressProvider().getExternalAddress() and
#   compared with each match record to decide LAN vs Internet;
# lock: guards matchList between the scan thread and update();
# hasScanned: set once the first listMatches() succeeded, switching the status text to
# matchList: the snapshot the scan thread publishes every 5s;
# scanThread: the thread running this Runnable, stopped by nulling it.
